approverDeclinePath.note: Immutable audit history — this decline is never edited or removed after the fact. overLimitPath._note: Loretta-only night (Station 06). No driver can do the pickup, so paid transport is explored: Loretta is willing but has no car, and her ride estimate is $12.40 — over Kendra's $10 paid-ride limit. The job does NOT fail and does NOT carry an APPROVAL_PENDING candidate: the flagged option is recorded overLimitCandidate and keeps reasonCode OVER_POLICY. Mission Control labels it "Ride estimate over your limit" and requires explicit acceptance; without acceptOverLimit the backend refuses with OVER_LIMIT_NOT_ACCEPTED and writes no confirmation. Nothing is booked and no provider is involved.
